lowball.panel.title: LOWBALL
lowball.tooltip.select: Arm the tool. While it is on, clicking a slot picks that item for pricing instead of moving it — the click is swallowed, so nothing reaches the server. Stays on across screens, so you can pick out of a chest and carry on in the trade window.
lowball.tooltip.send: Send what you have picked to the desktop app.
lowball.tooltip.send.offline: The desktop app is not running. What you send is held and delivered as soon as it starts.
lowball.tooltip.clear: Forget everything picked, here and on any other screen.
